images.title: The royal stable seen from above
images.purpose: Show a square stable with horses as dots, 5 on each side, with one corner horse counted on two sides.
images.composition: A square outline centred on white with dots for horses along the four sides and a ring on the one corner dot.
images.exact_structure: A square outline. Dots show horses: each side has exactly 5 dots and one corner dot is shared. 19 dots in all. One dot sits on the top left corner and counts for the top side and the left side; the other three corners are empty. Top side: the corner dot plus 4 dots. Left side: the same corner dot plus 4 dots. Right side: 5 dots, none at the corners. Bottom side: 5 dots, none at the corners. The shared corner dot is ringed in #CC79A7 with a thin arrow labelled 'counted on two sides'.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A horse at a corner stands on two sides, so it is counted twice when we count each side.
